args.title: Enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The export button should be re-enabled if an export fails, allowing the user to retry the operation without needing to reload the page.

label: bug
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export button is not re-enabled after a failed export, preventing further attempts to export without a page reload.
